## Device Matrix Impact
<!-- Should this add or change a known Strix Halo device profile in strix-halo-lib/device-profile-data.sh? -->

> **Adding or correcting a device profile? Attach a `--report` bundle from that
> machine.** Run `./strix-halo-setup.sh --report` (no sudo needed). Ten of the
> eleven profiles have never been seen on real hardware — they are DMI string
> matches written from spec sheets. A bundle is what turns one into a verified
> profile, and its fixture half becomes a permanent regression test.
>
> See [docs/contributing-a-device-fixture.md](../../docs/contributing-a-device-fixture.md)
> if you would rather capture and submit the fixture yourself.
